summary: Exports TouchDesigner geometry, scenes, cameras, PBR materials, textures, blend shapes, skeletons, and animation data to a glTF 2.0 .gltf or .glb file.

key_params.name: extension
key_params.note: Choose JSON-based .gltf or self-contained binary .glb output

key_params.name: exportmethod
key_params.note: Export the internal network or a referenced component

key_params.name: cameras
key_params.note: Include cameras in the exported scene

key_concepts: glTF Out COMP writes glTF 2.0 as separate JSON/buffer assets or a self-contained .glb.
Component Reference exports another network; Internal Network exports nodes inside the glTF Out COMP.
Automatic traversal follows render-enabled Geometry, Camera, Null-joint, and POP nodes.
PBR MATs provide the supported material path for exported Geometry COMPs.
Animation export can reuse glTF In COMP Import Select CHOPs or properly formatted full-range animation CHOPs.
common_gotchas: Automatic mode ignores otherwise valid nodes when their render flags are disabled.
Animation CHOPs must be non-time-sliced/full-range; quaternion channels are preferred over Euler rotations when both exist.
The referenced component itself is not exported as a node; traversal starts with its contents.
Procedural TouchDesigner networks are translated to glTF scene data, not preserved as procedural operator graphs.
